raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The batch 14 re-delivery (ingest 05:00) repeats all 338 of that batch's transactions, with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds instead of ISO strings. The epoch value 1768716261000 equals 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, which matches the original row for txn_id 904490. This breaks the TIMESTAMP cast and would also double-count those rows. The fix parses both formats and keeps one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, status, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) AS rn FROM parsed) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
